points.description: States the limitation that the wireframe representation is ambiguous: one wireframe model can represent more than one different solid object, so the model does not uniquely define the object. Equivalent wording earns the marks (e.g. 'the same wireframe could be interpreted as different solids').
points.partial_credit: 1 mark for naming the limitation only as ambiguous, unclear or messy/confusing, without saying that one wireframe can correspond to different solid objects. 2 marks for stating that one wireframe can represent different solids.
